correctness.rationale: Unitary Zak transform diagonalizes each critical-density modulation row and the second modulated row becomes a shift s->s-delta. Direct Poisson geometric expansion yields |Zg|²=(pi/w)²(a_s²+b_s²+2a_sb_sc)/(1+q²-2qc)² with a_s,b_s>=0, c=cos(2pi x). Its c derivative is nonnegative and strictly positive except isolated zeros; hence global extrema occur x=1/2 and x=0. The minimum fiber is 4q sinh²(L(s-1/2))/(1+q)²; minimizing on each wrap interval yields cosh(Ld)-1. The maximum fiber is strictly convex on each wrap chamber, so maxima occur at endpoints. Essential extrema equal optimal frame bounds by Zak-image concentration. Taylor yields A~8*pi^4*q/(1+q)^2 d²; strict convexity/symmetry yields unique half-offset. Checked actual RESULT.md Steps 1-6 and source verify_bounds.py, independently compared nine Zak spatial sums and 5,289 multiplier samples plus extremal fibers. Finite numerical checks are corroborative, not universal proof. Endpoints delta=0,1 are excluded; w>0 essential.
